I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and told Anselm in his DM.

The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". The mail gives the $2,101 per-seat figure from Marcus, says Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis to check with Anselm or June Osei-Lark before passing it on.

Anselm is the CFO, so his approval is enough for this figure to go to Hollis. Hollis's address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth doesn't need to approve the mail.

It's only a draft. Someone still needs to send it.
